What is Pasero?

Small by design. Complete for everyday research.

麻雀虽小，五脏俱全。

Pasero is not built to do everything. It is built to bring the everyday work of molecular biology into one place.

Most researchers use only a small part of Excel, Word, GraphPad Prism, and other specialized software—but still have to pay for the whole package and keep moving between apps.

Pasero brings together the tools you actually use: writing research notes, processing data, managing lab resources, reading literature, and working at the bench with mobile.

Pasero means “sparrow” in Esperanto. Its Chinese name, 雀角, comes from The Book of Songs: “Who says a sparrow has no horn? How then does it pierce my house?”

And 雀角 sounds like 缺觉—sleep-deprived. A familiar state for researchers.

No account. No cloud. Download and start working.

这就是我做 Pasero 的核心理念。

在研究中，我们会使用 Excel、Word、GraphPad Prism 和各种数据处理软件。很多时候，我们真正高频使用的功能只有几个，却仍要为整套软件付费，还要不断在不同工具之间来回切换。

所以，我做了 Pasero（雀角）：把分子生物学研究中真正需要的实验记录、数据处理、资源管理和文献工作，放进同一个轻巧的工作空间。

Pasero 在世界语中意为“麻雀”。“雀角”则出自《诗经·召南·行露》：

“谁谓雀无角？何以穿我屋？”

当然，它还有一个更贴近科研人的解释——“雀角”，也是“缺觉”。毕竟，这大概是每个科研人最熟悉的灵魂状态。

Behind Pasero

Built by a researcher, for researchers.

Pasero 背后的人

I’m Hong Yang—born and raised in Zunyi, Guizhou, and chronically short on sleep. I’m currently doing my best to overcome sleep deprivation and finish my PhD.

I built Pasero to reduce the time we spend switching between apps—and save a little more time for sleep. After all, we Guizhou people come from green mountains and clear waters. Beautiful places raise beautiful people, and beautiful people need their sleep.

If you are sleep-deprived too, welcome to Pasero / 雀角.

在下杨红，长期缺觉。

土生土长贵州省遵义市人，现在正努力克服缺觉，完成博士学业。

我做 Pasero，是想降低在软件之间切换的频率，省出时间来睡觉。因为我们贵州人，青山绿水出丽人。

如果你也缺觉，欢迎使用 Pasero / 雀角。
